content.name: Cameroon win the 1984 Africa Cup of Nations

attributes.summary: Held in Ivory Coast. Cameroon beat Algeria on penalties in the semi-final and beat Nigeria 3 to 1 in the final, with goals from René N'Djeya, Théophile Abega and Ernest Ebongué. It was their first African title, under captain Théophile Abega.

attributes.summary: Cameroon beat the holders Argentina in the opening match, reached the quarter-finals and became the first African team to do so. In the second round they beat Colombia 2 to 1, with the 38-year-old Roger Milla scoring twice in extra time. They lost 3 to 2 to England in extra time in the quarter-final.
